message:
The capability:
{
 "name": "Time off",
 "sheets": [
  {
   "name": "Requests",
   "kind": "list",
   "columns": [
    "Who (person; required)",
    "Type (choice; required; choices: Vacation, Sick, Personal)",
    "From (date; required)",
    "To (date; required)",
    "Days (computed; worked out: To − From + 1)",
    "Note (long_text)",
    "Status (step)",
    "Balance after (computed; worked out: Left in Balances for the same Who if Status is approved or taken, otherwise Left in Balances for the same Who − Days)"
   ],
   "steps": [
    "Submitted (start)",
    "Approved",
    "Declined (exit)",
    "Taken (last)"
   ],
   "row": "request / requests",
   "add_action": "Request time off",
   "sort": "Status ascending",
   "checks": [
    "Within your balance"
   ],
   "steps_detail": [
    {
     "name": "Submitted",
     "move_out": "anyone",
     "move_in": "anyone"
    },
    {
     "name": "Approved",
     "button": "Approve",
     "move_out": "anyone",
     "move_in": "not_submitter"
    },
    {
     "name": "Declined",
     "button": "Decline",
     "move_out": "anyone",
     "move_in": "not_submitter"
    },
    {
     "name": "Taken",
     "move_out": "anyone",
     "move_in": "anyone"
    }
   ]
  },
  {
   "name": "Balances",
   "kind": "list",
   "columns": [
    "Who (person; required)",
    "Year (number)",
    "Days a year (days)",
    "Used (days)",
    "Left (computed; worked out: Days a year − Used + the Who's leave entries added up)"
   ],
   "row": "balance / balances",
   "add_action": null,
   "sort": null,
   "checks": [],
   "steps_detail": []
  },
  {
   "name": "Holidays",
   "kind": "list",
   "columns": [
    "Date (date; required)",
    "Holiday (text; required)"
   ],
   "row": "holiday / holidays",
   "add_action": null,
   "sort": null,
   "checks": [],
   "steps_detail": []
  },
  {
   "name": "Leave entries",
   "kind": "ledger",
   "columns": [
    "Who (person; required)",
    "Days (days; required)",
    "Note (text)",
    "Balance after (days)",
    "Reverses (link; links to Leave entries)"
   ],
   "row": "entry / entries",
   "add_action": "Add entry",
   "sort": null,
   "checks": [],
   "steps_detail": []
  }
 ],
 "roles": [
  {
   "name": "Time off admins",
   "members": [
    "Lena Ortiz",
    "Wade Wilson"
   ],
   "can": [
    "see",
    "add",
    "edit",
    "delete",
    "move_steps",
    "customize"
   ],
   "rows": "every row"
  },
  {
   "name": "Everyone",
   "members": "everyone",
   "can": [
    "see",
    "add"
   ],
   "rows": "their own rows",
   "sheets": [
    "Requests",
    "Balances"
   ],
   "view": {
    "line": "Your requests and balance",
    "columns": [
     "From",
     "Days",
     "Type",
     "Status"
    ]
   }
  },
  {
   "name": "Everyone (holidays)",
   "members": "everyone",
   "can": [
    "see"
   ],
   "rows": "every row",
   "sheets": [
    "Holidays"
   ]
  },
  {
   "name": "Managers",
   "members": "everyone",
   "can": [
    "see",
    "move_steps"
   ],
   "rows": "their team's rows",
   "sheets": [
    "Requests"
   ],
   "view": {
    "line": "Your team’s requests",
    "columns": [
     "Who",
     "From",
     "Days",
     "Type",
     "Status"
    ]
   }
  }
 ],
 "rules": [
  "Requests go to the person’s manager.",
  "When a request is approved, tell the person and Lena.",
  "When a request is declined, tell the person and Lena.",
  "When a request is approved, add an entry to Leave entries for the person with its Days as a negative amount, so the days come off their balance."
 ]
}

How it works now:
Requests sheet
Who (person, required, whoever adds it), Type (Vacation, Sick or Personal, required), From (date, required), To (date, required), Note (long text).
A request is added only when Left in Balances for the same Who is empty or Days at most Left in Balances for the same Who (Within your balance).

Balances sheet
Who (person, required), Year (number), Days a year (days), Used (days).
Left counts the leave entries for its Who.

Holidays sheet
Date (date, required), Holiday (text, required).

Leave entries sheet
Who (person, required), Days (days, required), Note (text), Balance after (Who's entries added up, to this one), Reverses (the entry it reverses).
Leave entries are only added: one can't be changed or deleted, only reversed, once.

Steps
Submitted → Approved → Declined or Taken
Approved: not by the person who asked
Declined: not by the person who asked

What happens by itself
Requests go to the person’s manager.
When a request is approved, tell the person and Lena.
When a request is declined, tell the person and Lena.
When a request is approved, add an entry to Leave entries for the person with its Days as a negative amount, so the days come off their balance.

Who can see and do what
Lena Ortiz and Wade Wilson see every request, add, edit and move them, and change how it works.
Everyone sees their own requests and balances and can add them. Everyone also sees their own entries.
Everyone sees every holiday.
Everyone sees their team’s requests and can move them.

Connections
People fills Who.
People fills Who.
People fills Who.

Coming soon
